claim: For a finite Gibbs CE family and one Fréchet-induced direction, the centered BKM covariance of the coefficient-weighted sum of CE readouts equals the nested coefficient-weighted sum of all pairwise centered BKM responses; this quadratic is nonnegative.

carrier.type: The existing scalar-gauge quotient Operator n ⧸ scalarGauge n with quotientBKMForm, applied to actual finiteCEOperatorForm readouts on Carrier n = (realDerivationsLane (GibbsOperator n)).L
operations: finite real linear combinations in the scalar-gauge quotient
the existing bilinear quotient BKM form
the existing finite CE-derived operator one-forms
the proved aggregate centered BKM quadratic nonnegativity theorem
conventions: the (i,j) entry is centeredBKMRealCovariance of the i and j CE readouts at the same direction
the quadratic is ∑ i, c i • ∑ j, c j • entry(i,j)
the equality identifies this pairwise quadratic with the actual covariance of the summed operator readouts
no off-diagonal single-observable Onsager identification is implied

smallest_gap.description: Use the native scalar-gauge quotient and its existing bilinear quotient BKM form to expand the aggregate quadratic exactly into all pairwise family response entries. The equality is followed by nonnegativity from the already proved aggregate BKM theorem.

out_of_scope: Identification of cross-index Hessians with one single-observable Onsager system
